title: VC Sofinnova reels in €82M to target medtechs in the next 5 years
summary: Sofinnova Partners has hauled in 82 million euro ($93.3 million) in an oversubscribed financing round. The European venture capital group said it will use the cash to expand its medtech creation strategy in Europe and the U.S.

title: New approach methodologies in safety and toxicology testing: Why proving repeatability is the next hurdle for widespread adoption
summary: NAMs could transform drug safety testing—but proving repeatability and cell health remains the key hurdle to widespread adoption.

title: Indivior ends PAM drug collab with Addex ahead of Supernus merger

title: Roche's Genentech inks $1.5B bispecific pact with fast-rising Earendil
